name: googlefindmydevice-login-helper
description: Standalone, local-only tool to obtain Google Find Hub credentials for the ioBroker.googlefindmydevice adapter. Run this on any PC with a browser - never on a headless server, and never upload its output anywhere.

scripts.build: npm run bundle && pkg dist/bundle.cjs --targets node18-win-x64,node18-macos-x64,node18-linux-x64 --output dist/login-helper --config pkg.config.json --no-bytecode
